NFL Draft Prospect Tiers

Cut Imbalance Clustering on Combine Measurables + College Career Stats

11 Position Groups | Combine + cfbfastR Data

Draft Prospect Tier Results

Draft prospects are tiered using combine measurables (40-yard dash, vertical jump, broad jump, height, weight, etc.) combined with college career production stats aggregated from cfbfastR play-by-play data. All statistics are weighted equally in the preference matrix. Hover over a player to see their stats and rank among the position group.
